name: Ephara
description: Ephara is the white-blue god of the polis on Theros, who embodies law, civilization, scholarship and civic order and is worshipped especially in Meletis.

description_citations.work: The Gods of Born of the Gods
description_citations.text: "The Gods of Born of the Gods" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2014.

summary.text: Ephara is the white-blue god of the polis on Theros, who embodies law, civilization, scholarship and civic order and is worshipped especially in Meletis.

citations.work: The Gods of Born of the Gods
citations.text: "The Gods of Born of the Gods" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jan 2014.

bio.text: She bestowed magic on the people of Meletis, letting Kynaios and Tiro overthrow the tyrant Archon Agnomakhos and found the city.

citations.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Meletis", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Theros (plane)", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: When Ashiok's experiment of disturbing citizens' dreams created the god Cacophony, Ephara destroyed it as a threat to social harmony.

citations.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

bio.text: She appeared to Perisophia in a dream-vision to warn that war was coming and that a tyrant tore at the threshold of the world.

citations.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.
"Perisophia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the Silence of the Gods she withdrew her direct presence from the world.

citations.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: In the New Phyrexian Invasion most gods were compleated, but Meletis held out with Ephara's aid, and she appeared defending Theros and blessing its champions with godfire.

citations.text: "Meletis", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Not compleated: she is described as a minor god of Theros who survived the Phyrexian invasion, and she still defends Meletis.

citations.text: "List of deities". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Meletis", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ephara bestows magic on the people of Meletis, letting them overthrow the tyrant Archon Agnomakhos.
timeline.quote: Ephara once bestowed magic upon the people of Meletis

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ephara destroys the newborn god Cacophony as a threat to social harmony.
timeline.quote: Ephara personally ended his existence.

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Silence of the Gods enacted by Kruphix, Ephara withdraws her direct presence from the world.
timeline.quote: Ephara — like her fellow deities — withdrew her direct presence from the world.

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Ephara appears in Elesh Norn's vision defending Theros and blesses its champions with godfire.
timeline.quote: She blessed the champions of Theros with divine flame

citation.text: "Ephara", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians exploit belief on Theros, compleating followers and Heliod.
timeline.quote: it is known that Heliod was compleated and Ephara was not

citation.text: "List of deities", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kynaios and Tiro, aided by Ephara's magic, overthrow the tyrant Agnomakhos and cast out the leonin.
timeline.quote: With their new power, Kynaios and Tiro overthrew Agnomakhos, cast out the leonin, and freed Meletis from tyranny.

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Meletis is founded on the ruins of Agnomakhos's empire and Kynaios and Tiro relinquish power to a philosopher-led republic.
timeline.quote: which ultimately led them to relinquish their power and establish a philosopher-led republic

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ephara keeps her temple standing through an earthquake and later shares designs so Meletis can be rebuilt.
timeline.quote: Ephara kept her temple standing throughout the mighty quake

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Religion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The leonin lose to the human rebels Kynaios and Tiro after Ephara gifts mortals with magic, and flee to Oreskos when the archon empire falls.
timeline.quote: As the empire of the archons fell, the leonin fled to Oreskos.

citation.text: "Oreskos", section "Age of Trax". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ephara inspires Kynaios and Tiro to overthrow the Archon tyrant Agnomakhos and found Meletis.
timeline.quote: Ephara inspired and equipped the human heroes Kynaios and Tiro to overthrow Agnomakhos.

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "Birth of the poleis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a dream-vision in a void of stars, Ephara asks Perisophia about Meletis and warns that war is coming and a tyrant tears at the threshold of the world.
timeline.quote: War is coming. A tyrant tears at the threshold of our world and yours

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Perisophia vows to speak only words that uplift the human mind and soul with her dying breath.
timeline.quote: With my dying breath I will speak only words that uplift the human mind and soul.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

timeline.summary: Ashiok's experiment of disturbing citizens' dreams creates the god Cacophony, whom Ephara quickly slays.
timeline.quote: The newborn god was quickly slain by Ephara

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "Theros". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In a dream, Melantha dines with her dead mentor Xenocrates, who drinks wine from a poisoned goblet and coughs up blood as he voices blasphemous theories; she wakes screaming.
timeline.quote: I did not... I did not kill you, Xenocrates.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: Ephara appears, calls Cacophony a monstrosity and plunges her hands into it, draining its life; the god of cities never wakes again.
timeline.quote: Cacophony, the god of cities dark, never woke again.

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR Phyrexian forces compleat most of the gods; Meletis holds out with Ephara's aid and Kroxa obliterates invaders outside.
timeline.quote: Meletis stood as the last bastion of resistance against an endless onslaught of Phyrexian armies.

citation.text: "Meletis", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Most gods are compleated while Meletis holds out with Ephara's aid, and Kroxa obliterates invaders in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: The city of Meletis stood as the last bastion of resistance against an endless onslaught of Phyrexian armies.

citation.text: "Theros (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ephara speaks over Cacophony and challenges the unseen mortal responsible to reveal themselves.
timeline.quote: Ephara challenged the mortal responsible for this atrocity to reveal themselves.

citation.text: "Cacophony", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ephara plunges her hands into Cacophony and unmakes it.
timeline.quote: Ephara extended her hands, plunging them into Cacophony.

citation.text: "Cacophony", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ephara visits Perisophia in dreams and warns of Xenagos.
timeline.quote: the god warned her champion of the coming of Xenagos

citation.text: "Perisophia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Ephara calls Meletis her city and Perisophia reports to her.
relations.quote: "How is my city?" The voice of Ephara echoed into the void.

citation.text: "The Nature of Identity" by Wizards of the Coast. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2014.

relations.note: Iris is the Oracle of Ephara and lives in servitude to her god and polis.
relations.quote: Although she lived in servitude to her god and her polis

citation.text: "The Oracle of Ephara" by Jeremiah Isgur. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Mar 2014.

relations.note: Melantha is a priestess of Ephara's temple and on the high council.
relations.quote: to balance the demands of serving her god with finding acceptance among her peers

citation.text: "Dreams of the City" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2014.

relations.note: Mogis harbors deep disdain for her.
relations.quote: he harbors deep disdain for Ephara and Karametra

citation.text: "Mogis", section "Influence and Goals". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: She is also a Chosen of the god Ephara .

citation.text: "Perisophia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Haraksi the smith, priest of the lesser peristyle

citation.text: "Skophos", section "Notable Skophans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
